item.title: IKEA launches second-hand service in Sweden
item.description: IKEA is entering the Swedish second-hand market with the launch of a digital platform for reselling its own brand of used furniture, Azernews reports.

item.title: Producer prices fall in Spain in December
item.description: Producer prices in Spain fell by 3% in December compared to the same month last year, according to a report released Monday by the country’s National Statistics Institute (INE), Azernews reports, citing foreign media.

item.title: EU to ban Russian gas imports from 2027
item.description: On Monday, the Council of the European Union reached an agreement on rules to ban the import of Russian gas, according to a statement from the EU press service, Azernews reports.

item.title: "Zootopia 2" tops Hollywood box office in China
item.description: The animated film “Zootopia 2” has earned $632 million in China, setting a new record for Hollywood films in the country, Azernews reports.

item.title: Chinese open-source AI models gain global market share
item.description: In November last year, Chinese AI models significantly increased their presence in the global market, rising from 1% to 15%, thanks in large part to the widespread use of open-source code, according to data from Nikkei, Azernews reports.

item.title: How Azerbaijan is cutting China–Europe transit times through Middle Corridor
item.description: The operational intensity of the corridor is also increasing. Eight freight trains were dispatched on the Xi’an–Baku route in January 2026, compared to eleven in December 2025, reflecting both seasonal fluctuations and ongoing optimization of schedules. Since the launch of regular container train services on the Middle Corridor in 2019, traffic has grown steadily, with more than 400 train runs recorded in 2025 alone.

item.title: Zakharova on EU gas ban: Europe gave up freedom
item.description: Russian Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Maria Zakharova on Monday criticized the European Union's decision to ban all imports of Russian liquefied natural gas (LNG) to the bloc, claiming that the Europeans have "given up their freedom", Azernews reports.

item.title: Suspects detained over alleged plot to attack foreign embassy in Baku
item.description: Operational and investigative measures carried out by Azerbaijan’s State Security Service (SSS) have raised well-founded suspicions that three Azerbaijani citizens were preparing to carry out a terrorist attack on a foreign country’s embassy in Baku on the grounds of religious hostility.

item.title: Azerbaijani Parliament Speaker arrives in UAE for Mediterranean Parliamentary Assembly Forum
item.description: Speaker of Azerbaijan’s Milli Majlis, Sahiba Gafarova, has arrived in the United Arab Emirates on a working visit to take part in the 2nd Session of the Women Parliamentarians Forum of the Parliamentary Assembly of the Mediterranean.

item.title: Old carpets turn into vibrant art pieces in Ganja
item.description: Within Arts Council Azerbaijan, art project "Second Life" (İkinci Həyat), a creative workshop and exhibition, has been held in Ganja, transforming the city's urban space into an open-air art venue, Azernews reports.
